craft_notes: Sthāyin: secrecy-injunction (the text's heaviest verse per C1: supreme nectar told, never shown — ever). Rows: row 3 (highest→ever). Close: ever (kadācana — never...ever: the absolute closes; the paradox kept flat, no softening). Rejected: 'esoteric transmission' — killed: never-shown kept (the withholding IS the verse); 'to the worthy' added — killed: of anyone kept (the verse withholds first, gives next verse).

lines: Thus told, Goddess — supreme nectar, highest:
never to be shown of anyone, but ever.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ity etat kathitaṃ devi paramāmṛtam uttamam | etac ca naiva kasyāpi prakāśyaṃ tu kadācana

reads_against.argmap: Who may hear this? → Supreme nectar — told, yet never to be shown to just anyone, ever.
c1_essence: Supreme nectar told — never to be shown to anyone.
